name: how-does-a-hold-work
description: Hand-written for design/22 #2's quick reply, so a keyless panel answers it. No figures, so it reads true in any state.

content.text: Your bidding power is a hold with PayPal, not a charge. You approve it in a PayPal window. When bidding closes, you pay only for the lots you win, and the rest of the hold is released.
